sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我在凌晨4点半给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗星星的背后有什么。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我要测试七张床垫。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联盟里最好的球队。

sentences.en: I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天使用不同的首字母开局词。

sentences.en: And I love a one pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 而且我很喜欢一个锅搞定的食谱，因为我不喜欢洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》庆祝成立175周年，陪伴您理解世界，充实度过每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即订阅，享受nytimes.com slash subscribe的特惠。

sentences.en: Today we have something really special for you.
sentences.zh: 今天我们为你准备了一些特别的东西。

sentences.en: A blissful break from the news.
sentences.zh: 一段远离新闻的愉悦休憩。

sentences.en: It's a new series from NYT Audio called Animal.
sentences.zh: 这是来自纽约时报音频部的一档新节目，叫做《动物》。

sentences.en: My colleague Sam Anderson from The Times Magazine traveled the world to have encounters with animals.
sentences.zh: 我的同事、《时报杂志》的萨姆·安德森环游世界去与动物相遇。

sentences.en: Not to claim them or to tame them, but just to appreciate them.
sentences.zh: 不是为了占有它们或驯服它们，而只是为了欣赏它们。

sentences.en: Each episode is a journey to get closer to a creature that Sam loves.
sentences.zh: 每一集都是一次旅程，去走近萨姆所热爱的一种生物。

sentences.en: For the next six weeks, we'll be running this limited series every Sunday here on the Daily Feed.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的六周里，我们将在每周日于此处的“每日动态”节目中播出这档限定系列。

sentences.en: But if you want to hear all the episodes right now, you can search for it wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 但如果你现在就想听所有的单集，你可以在任何你获取播客的地方搜索它。

sentences.en: Turn right into the parking lot, then arrive at your destination.
sentences.zh: 向右转进入停车场，然后到达您的目的地。

sentences.en: Oh my God, that license plate says I love my ferrets.
sentences.zh: 噢天哪，那个车牌写着我爱我的雪貂。
好吧，我们去登记入住吧。

sentences.en: I'm going to be honest with you.
My life is dull and soft.
sentences.zh: 我的生活枯燥而又温吞。

sentences.en: I'm basically a human butter knife.
sentences.zh: 我基本上就是一把人类黄油刀。

sentences.en: But there's one thing that instantly fills me with joy.
sentences.zh: 但有一件事能瞬间让我充满喜悦。
一种眩晕的、吱吱叫的、孩童般的喜悦。

sentences.en: They're loading up a cart full of, like, ferret products.
sentences.zh: 他们正在往推车里装各种雪貂用品。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Sam Anderson.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是萨姆·安德森。

sentences.en: How many ferrets were in that van?
sentences.zh: 那辆面包车里有多少只雪貂？

sentences.en: It's August, and I've just arrived with my colleague, Crystal Duhaime, in Columbus, Ohio, which, at this moment, happens to be the most ferret-y place in America.
sentences.zh: 现在是八月，我和同事克rystal·杜海姆刚抵达俄亥俄州哥伦布市，此时此刻，这里恰好是全美雪貂味最浓的地方。
女人们从四面八方赶来。

sentences.en: Because ferret enthusiasts from all over the country are pouring in for one of the major stops on the national ferret circuit.
sentences.zh: 因为来自全国各地的雪貂爱好者正蜂拥而至，参加全国雪貂巡回赛的重要站点之一。

sentences.en: A competition called the Ferret Buckeye Bash.
sentences.zh: 一场名为“七叶树雪貂狂欢节”的比赛。

sentences.en: Basically, imagine the prestige of the Westminster Dog Show.
sentences.zh: 基本上，你可以想象一下威斯敏斯特犬展的声望。

sentences.en: But instead of beagles and Pomeranians, it's just hundreds of ferrets.
sentences.zh: 但主角不是小猎犬和博美犬，而是几百只雪貂。

sentences.en: I'm sorry, this is a rolling tower of ferrets.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，这是一座移动的雪貂塔。

sentences.en: As we're standing in the lobby of the official competition hotel, a woman walks in, rolling a luggage cart stacked with cages.
sentences.zh: 当我们站在官方比赛酒店的大堂时，一个女人走了进来，推着一辆堆满笼子的行李车。

sentences.en: There's four in here, two in here, three in there.
sentences.zh: 这里有四个，这里有两个，那里有三个。

sentences.en: There's brown ferrets, albino ferrets, ferrets lounging around in miniature hammocks, and snuggled up in comfy little beds.
sentences.zh: 有棕色的雪貂，白化的雪貂，在迷你吊床里闲逛的雪貂，以及蜷缩在舒适小窝里的雪貂。
这是菲尼亚斯·威瑟尔顿。
你刚才说菲尼亚斯·威瑟尔顿？

sentences.en: You should see what I've got in my car.
sentences.zh: 你应该看看我车里有什么。

sentences.en: I want to see what you've got in my car.
sentences.zh: 我想看看你车里有什么。

sentences.en: I'm helping her and her ferret friends unload.
sentences.zh: 我正在帮她和她的雪貂朋友们卸货。

sentences.en: A ferret, for anyone who doesn't know, is basically a weasel.
sentences.zh: 雪貂，对于不了解的人来说，基本上就是黄鼠狼。

sentences.en: It's long and tubular, sort of like a badger crossed with a snake, but also crossed with a teddy bear.
sentences.zh: 它们又长又呈管状，有点像獾和蛇的结合体，但也像泰迪熊。

sentences.en: What am I seeing in the cage that these ferrets are eating?
sentences.zh: 我在笼子里看到这些雪貂在吃什么？

sentences.en: Well, this is salad and chewies over here, but...
sentences.zh: 嗯，这边是沙拉和磨牙零食，但是……

sentences.en: Some of the cages we're unloading are littered with bones and carcasses of, like, whole dead birds.
sentences.zh: 我们正在卸货的一些笼子里到处都是骨头和类似整只死鸟的尸体。
为什么这只雪貂是秃的？

sentences.en: They have adrenal disease, which is common, especially in martial ferrets.
sentences.zh: 它们患有肾上腺疾病，这很常见，尤其是在绝育的雪貂中。

sentences.en: This might be the place to mention that ferrets can be pretty polarizing pets.
sentences.zh: 这里或许值得一提的是，雪貂可能会引起两极分化的宠物。

sentences.en: People who love them, like me, really love them.
sentences.zh: 喜欢它们的人，比如我，非常喜欢它们。

sentences.en: And people who don't love them, which is probably most of humanity, really do not love them.
sentences.zh: 而不喜欢它们的人，大概占了人类的大多数，是真的很不喜欢它们。

sentences.en: Wait, what happens if I put my fingers in that bottom cage?
sentences.zh: 等等，如果我把手指伸进那个底层的笼子里会发生什么？

sentences.en: The word ferret comes from the Latin for little thief.
sentences.zh: 雪貂（ferret）这个词源于拉丁语，意为小偷。

sentences.en: They were domesticated basically yesterday, historically speaking, around 2,500 years ago.
sentences.zh: 从历史角度来看，它们基本上昨天才被驯化，大约在2500年前。

sentences.en: Just for reference, dogs were domesticated more like 20,000 years ago.
sentences.zh: 作为参考，狗被驯化的时间更接近2万年前。

sentences.en: And ferrets were mainly used to hunt rodents and rabbits.
sentences.zh: 雪貂主要用于猎捕啮齿动物和兔子。

sentences.en: They have sharp claws and oily fur and glands that make them smell weird and also extremely strong jaws, which they are not at all afraid to use.
sentences.zh: 它们有尖锐的爪子、油性的皮毛、带有奇怪气味的腺体，还有极度强壮的下巴，而且它们一点也不介意使用这些。

sentences.en: In fact, this is part of why ferrets are actually illegal to keep as pets in a couple of states.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这也是为什么在几个州雪貂实际上被法律禁止作为宠物饲养的原因之一。

sentences.en: But in spite of all that, I have loved ferrets my whole life.
sentences.zh: 但尽管如此，我一生都深爱着雪貂。

sentences.en: As a kid growing up in Oregon, I desperately wanted one.
sentences.zh: 作为一个在俄勒冈州长大的孩子，我极其渴望拥有一只。

sentences.en: They were at all the pet stores I went to.
sentences.zh: 我去过的所有宠物店里都有它们。

sentences.en: And I'd go running past the gerbils and hamsters and parakeets and just stand there with the ferrets,
sentences.zh: 我会跑过沙鼠、仓鼠和长尾小鹦鹉，直接站在雪貂那里，

sentences.en: communing for as long as I could, letting them bite my fingers through the cage.
sentences.zh: 尽可能久地与它们交流，任由它们透过笼子咬我的手指。

sentences.en: But I was never allowed to take one home.
sentences.zh: 但我从来不被允许带一只回家。

sentences.en: Unfulfilled childhood dreams, they don't just die.
sentences.zh: 未竟的童年梦想，它们不会轻易消逝。

sentences.en: I feel like I might go home this weekend with some ferrets.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我这个周末可能会带几只雪貂回家。

sentences.en: They follow you around and scratch at you and burrow a hole deep into your heart.
sentences.zh: 它们跟着你，挠你，在你的心底深深地挖了一个洞。

sentences.en: Which is why I've come all the way here to the official hotel of the Ferret Buckeye Bash.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我大老远来到这里，来到七叶树雪貂狂欢节的官方酒店。

sentences.en: You guys have a big hand.
Because this hotel is filling up fast with chaotic ferrets and ferret people.
sentences.zh: 因为这家酒店正迅速被混乱的雪貂和养雪貂的人填满。

sentences.en: All the way down here, huh?
One of whom has agreed to help fulfill my childhood dream by initiating me into the ferret lifestyle.
sentences.zh: 其中一人同意帮助我实现童年梦想，带我体验雪貂的生活方式。

sentences.en: But the first ferret we meet is actually a large dog.
sentences.zh: 但我们遇到的第一只雪貂其实是一只大狗。

sentences.en: Yeah, I just adopted her on Tuesday, so we're still kind of getting to know each other.
sentences.zh: 对，我周二刚收养了她，所以我们还在互相了解中。

sentences.en: Erin Ehrman just drove here from upstate New York.
sentences.zh: 艾琳·埃尔曼刚刚从纽约州北部开车来到这里。

sentences.en: Many hours in her tiny car with not only Millie, her newly adopted dog, but also her friend Karen and, of course, her ferrets, whose cages are now wedged around the room.
sentences.zh: 在她那辆极小的车里度过了好几个小时，不仅有米莉——她新收养的狗，还有她的朋友凯伦，当然，还有她的雪貂，它们的笼子现在塞满了房间。

sentences.en: There's one by the microwave, one by the coffee maker.
sentences.zh: 微波炉旁边有一个，咖啡机旁边有一个。

sentences.en: Well, should we meet some buddies?
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们要不要去见见一些好伙伴？

sentences.en: This is Erin's first time competing in the Buckeye Bash.
sentences.zh: 这是艾琳第一次参加七叶树狂欢节比赛。

sentences.en: Genesis looks exactly like the ferret of my childhood dreaMs.
sentences.zh: 杰尼斯看起来完全符合我童年梦想中的雪貂形象。

sentences.en: Here, actually, you want to hold her?
sentences.zh: 来，实际上，你想抱抱她吗？

sentences.en: You know that classic thing they do in movies when they want to show something is beautiful, the shaft of heavenly light pouring down, angel choir singing?
sentences.zh: 你知道电影里那种经典桥段吗？为了展现某个东西很美，一束圣光从天而降，还有天使唱诗班。

sentences.en: Well, a majestic heavenly light is not worthy of Genesis.
sentences.zh: 嗯，雄伟的圣光根本配不上吉尼斯。

sentences.en: If you really wanted to signify the spectacular, otherworldly beauty of Genesis, you'd have to make a shaft of little Genesises pouring down from the sky.
sentences.zh: 如果你真想体现吉尼斯那惊人的、超凡脱俗的美，你得弄一束由小吉尼斯组成的瀑布从天而降。

sentences.en: Genesis is really checking me out.
Genesis is also the key to Erin's ferret future, because Erin wants to breed ferrets.
sentences.zh: 吉尼斯也是艾琳貂类未来的关键，因为艾琳想培育雪貂。

sentences.en: So if I could have, like, just a whole line of ferrets that have her temperament and her structure, I'd be very happy with that.
sentences.zh: 所以如果我能拥有一整排像她这样性格和体型的雪貂，我就会非常开心。

sentences.en: She has such a sweet face.
sentences.zh: 她长了一张好甜美的脸。

sentences.en: So is she your big hope for the competition, Genesis?
sentences.zh: 所以她是你在这次比赛中的最大希望吗，吉尼斯？

sentences.en: Um, for him, he's just going to show because he's going to show.
sentences.zh: 至于他，他来参赛纯粹就是为了露个脸。

sentences.en: This is when we turn our attention to the other competitor in the room.
sentences.zh: 这时候，我们将目光转向房间里的另一位选手。

sentences.en: This ferret is light brown and weirdly small.
sentences.zh: 这只雪貂是浅棕色的，而且小得离谱。

sentences.en: But he's still a juvenile, so...
And where Genesis is calm and thoughtful and seems to be reciting poetry in her mind, Gooseberry is an absolute freak.
sentences.zh: 而如果说吉尼斯沉着、深思熟虑、好像脑子里在背诗的话，那醋栗就是一个彻头彻尾的怪咖。

sentences.en: He's trying his darndest to get out.
sentences.zh: 他正拼了老命想逃出去。

sentences.en: He won't stop moving, thrashing around in circles, biting the bars of his cage.
sentences.zh: 他一刻也不停地动，在原地团团转地挣扎，还咬着笼子的栏杆。

sentences.en: What are you doing with your claws?
And at six months old, he's technically an adolescent hob.
sentences.zh: 才六个月大，严格来说他是一只未成年公貂。

sentences.en: Or, in human terms, a teenaged male.
sentences.zh: 或者用人类的话来说，就是个十几岁的少年。

sentences.en: Did he try to take a bite out of the mic?
sentences.zh: 他刚才是不是想咬一口麦克风？

sentences.en: He grabbed the mic with his paw.
sentences.zh: 他用爪子抓住了麦克风。

sentences.en: What kind of animal acts like this?
sentences.zh: 什么动物会有这种行为？

sentences.en: As Gooseberry works on destroying his cage, there's a knock on the door.
sentences.zh: 正当醋栗努力拆家时，门敲响了。
不好意思，我们要剪一下……
这是你家小宝贝的证件。

sentences.en: I had no idea you could get a ferret delivered like a pizza.
sentences.zh: 我压根不知道雪貂还能像披萨一样外送。

sentences.en: So this is the first time I'm meeting this guy.
sentences.zh: 所以这是我第一次见到这家伙。
他咬你的时候也很温柔吗？

sentences.en: When did you first encounter a ferret?
sentences.zh: 你是什么时候第一次接触到雪貂的？

sentences.en: Um, okay, so I grew up in California and they're not legal there.
sentences.zh: 嗯，好吧，我是在加州长大的，那里雪貂不合法。

sentences.en: So I didn't actually come into contact with a ferret until I was an adult and moved out of California.
sentences.zh: 所以我直到成年搬离加州后，才真正接触到雪貂。

sentences.en: I didn't hold one until 2019 and the first one I held was Mr. Groot Groot and I had to have him.
sentences.zh: 我直到2019年才抱过第一只，我抱的第一只叫大格鲁特，我当时就认定必须拥有他。

sentences.en: Um, as soon as I held him, I just kind of knew that's what I wanted.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我一抱他，就差不多知道这就是我想要的。

sentences.en: That's, I don't know how else to explain it.
sentences.zh: 就是……我不知道该怎么解释。

sentences.en: I guess some people say that there's like a dog shaped hole in their heart or a cat shaped hole.
sentences.zh: 我想有人说过，人们心里都有一个狗形状或者猫形状的空洞。

sentences.en: So I guess it would be like a ferret shaped hole.
sentences.zh: 所以我想这就类似于一个雪貂形状的空洞吧。

sentences.en: And a ferret would get right into that hole.
sentences.zh: 而雪貂刚好能填满那个洞。

sentences.en: I also have a ferret shaped hole in my heart.
sentences.zh: 我心里也有一个雪貂形状的空洞。

sentences.en: My childhood was kind of chaotic.
There was a divorce and a bunch of step parents.
sentences.zh: 经历过离婚，还有一堆继父母。

sentences.en: And we always seem to be moving, including a big move from Oregon to California, where ferrets are illegal.
sentences.zh: 而且我们好像总是在搬家，包括从俄勒冈州大举搬迁到雪貂非法的加州。

sentences.en: And so every summer when I'd go back up to Oregon to live with my dad, I would see the ferrets in the pet stores and I would beg him to get me one.
sentences.zh: 所以每年夏天我回俄勒冈跟爸爸住的时候，我都会在宠物店看到雪貂，然后哀求他给我买一只。

sentences.en: And in my little tiny child mind, everything would have been fine if I could have just had a pet ferret.
sentences.zh: 在我小小的童年世界里，只要我能养一只宠物雪貂，一切就都会好起来的。

sentences.en: I think they're grounding for me.
sentences.zh: 我觉得它们能让我踏实。

sentences.en: Which is ironic because they're very crazy, right?
sentences.zh: 这很讽刺，因为它们其实非常疯狂，对吧？

sentences.en: They're kind of off the wall.
sentences.zh: 它们有点像脱缰的野马。

sentences.en: But it's like you really have to be there with them.
sentences.zh: 但这就好像你必须真正和它们待在一起。

sentences.en: Yeah, you have to be in the moment.
Yeah, they're very in the present moment.
sentences.zh: 对，它们非常专注于当下。

sentences.en: Um, I do have a hard time being in the moment myself.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我自己其实很难做到活在当下。

sentences.en: Like, I'm usually thinking about either the past or the future and I miss the moment.
sentences.zh: 比如，我通常不是在想过去就是在想未来，然后就错过了当下。
嗯，但跟它们在一起不会。

sentences.en: You have to be in the moment with them.
sentences.zh: 你必须和它们一起活在当下。

sentences.en: Um, so, he's being silly, isn't he?
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以，他现在在犯傻，对吧？

sentences.en: He turned himself upside down and bit the bar.
sentences.zh: 他把自己倒挂过来咬栏杆。

sentences.en: It's like hanging upside down from it.
sentences.zh: 就像是从上面倒挂下来一样。
雪貂本身就是一个悖论。

sentences.en: It's so chaotic that it wraps all the way around into zen.
sentences.zh: 它混乱到极致，反而转变成了一种禅意。
绝对的混乱迫使你达到绝对的专注。

sentences.en: And so, tomorrow, when I am immersed in hundreds of squiggly wiggly ferrets at this show,
sentences.zh: 所以明天，当我在这场展会上被成百上千只扭来扭去的雪貂包围时，

sentences.en: I'm going to be so freaking present.
I might be fully in the moment for the first time in my whole life.
sentences.zh: 我可能这辈子第一次能完全活在当下。

sentences.en: All right, we should let everyone get to bed.
sentences.zh: 好了，我们该让大家去睡觉了。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for letting us hang in the hotel room.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你们让我们在酒店房间里待着。

sentences.en: And who knows what could happen then?
sentences.zh: 谁知道接下来会发生什么呢？

sentences.en: Might have to figure out how to get eight ferrets sleeping in hammocks onto the airplane home.
sentences.zh: 可能得琢磨怎么把八只睡在吊床里的雪貂带上飞回家的飞机。

sentences.en: And a bunch of dead birds for them to snack on.
sentences.zh: 还有一堆供它们当零食的死鸟。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》游戏板块拼字游戏《Connections》的创作者。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
And I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我每天负责创作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》这两款游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做联觉的特质。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 听音乐时我能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由活生生的人制作的。

sentences.en: Like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 就像刚才你们听到声音的那些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games 开始今天的游戏吧。

sentences.en: Erin, how do you not have a ferret vanity license plate?
sentences.zh: 艾琳，你怎么没有一块雪貂个性车牌？

sentences.en: I really, if I get a SUV or a wagon, I want to call it the woozle wagon.
sentences.zh: 如果我买一辆SUV或旅行车，我真想把它叫做“水獭车”。

sentences.en: And like have that on the back of it as a decal.
sentences.zh: 然后在车屁股贴上贴花。

sentences.en: And then like woozle one as the license plate.
sentences.zh: 车牌就用“水獭1号”之类的。

sentences.en: The next morning, we meet Erin in a parking lot at the Ohio State Fairgrounds.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，我们在俄亥俄州立集市广场的停车场见到了艾琳。

sentences.en: Oh, I just noticed your earrings.
sentences.zh: 哦，我刚注意到你的耳环。

sentences.en: Erin is all decked out in ferret gear.
sentences.zh: 艾琳浑身上下都是雪貂装备。
耳环、T恤、紫色的雪貂靴子。

sentences.en: This is the day where you win.
sentences.zh: 这是你大获全胜的日子。
吉尼斯看起来光彩照人。

sentences.en: Yeah, she looks even prettier this morning than she did last night.
sentences.zh: 对啊，她今天早上看起来比昨晚还要漂亮。

sentences.en: Now you can see her in the full light.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以借着充足的光线看清她了。

sentences.en: Look how clean and perfect she is.
sentences.zh: 看她多么干净、多么完美。

sentences.en: I can't even talk to you.
We are a real parade of animals heading toward the hall.
sentences.zh: 我们真像一群浩浩荡荡的动物向大厅走去。

sentences.en: And Aaron's friend Karen is walking Millie the dog.
sentences.zh: 而亚伦的朋友凯伦正带着狗米莉散步。

sentences.en: Are we going in that way?
But it turns out we're actually too many animals.
sentences.zh: 但结果证明，我们的动物确实太多了。

sentences.en: You know no animals are allowed in here.
sentences.zh: 你知道这里不允许带动物进来。

sentences.en: You can't have a dog in the spare chill hall.
sentences.zh: 你不能把狗带进备用休息大厅里。

sentences.en: What are you going to do with him then?
The woman in charge of the ferret show, Scarlett, is saying that Millie has to go.
sentences.zh: 负责雪貂展的负责人斯卡利说米莉必须离开。

sentences.en: That will set all the ferrets off.
sentences.zh: 那会把所有的雪貂都惹毛的。

sentences.en: We don't want them biting the judge.
sentences.zh: 我们可不想它们咬裁判。

sentences.en: And as we're standing there clutching our animals, the line behind us starts to back up.
sentences.zh: 正当我们紧紧抱着动物站在那儿时，我们身后的队伍开始排起了长龙。

sentences.en: Do you know how many ferrets in there don't even know what a dog is?
sentences.zh: 你知道里面有多少雪貂甚至不知道狗是什么吗？

sentences.en: And you know how good their smelling is?
sentences.zh: 而且你知道它们的嗅觉有多灵敏吗？

sentences.en: And I am finding this extremely stressful.

sentences.zh: 所以这把它们全激怒了。

sentences.en: You need me to do it?
That's when Erin's friend Karen very stoically announces that she is going to walk Millie back to the hotel.
sentences.zh: 就在这时，艾琳的朋友凯伦非常坚决地宣布她要带着米莉走回酒店。

sentences.en: Halfway across Columbus, Ohio with this dog she just met.
sentences.zh: 带着这只刚认识的狗穿越俄亥俄州哥伦布市的一半路程。

sentences.en: And she takes the leash and just heads off.
sentences.zh: 然后她拿着牵引绳就出发了。

sentences.en: Where did you say we were?
So with the dog gone and feeling slightly shell-shocked, we are finally allowed to enter the hall where we meet up with some of Erin's ferret friends.
sentences.zh: 随着狗狗的离开，带着些许震惊，我们终于得以进入大厅，并与艾琳的一些雪貂朋友会合了。

sentences.en: Do you feel bad at all about getting yelled at by Scarlet on your way in the door?
sentences.zh: 你在进门时被斯卡利大声训斥，心里有没有觉得很不舒服？

sentences.en: Because I have no idea what's going on.
sentences.zh: 因为我根本不知道发生了什么。

sentences.en: Everybody will get yelled at by Scarlet.
sentences.zh: 每个人都会被斯卡利训斥的。

sentences.en: It's like a, it's just a thing.
sentences.zh: 这就跟，这就跟常态一样。

sentences.en: You just kind of have to take it and like keep going.
sentences.zh: 你只能全盘接受然后继续前行。

sentences.en: That's kind of perfect because like ferret owners are the people who could do that the best, right?
sentences.zh: 这简直太完美了，因为雪貂主人就是最能做到这一类事情的人，对吧？

sentences.en: They actually all take it very well.
sentences.zh: 其实大家都能把这处理得很好。

sentences.en: I just nod and smile because like I really don't know what the hell is going on.
sentences.zh: 我只能点头微笑，因为我真的不知道到底发生了什么。

sentences.en: You seem, I have to say you seem comfortable existing like in a level of sort of chaos.
sentences.zh: 我得说，你似乎很适应这种程度的混乱。

sentences.en: You seem chill and stuff's going on all around you.
sentences.zh: 周围发生着各种事，你看起来还是很淡定。

sentences.en: You don't quite know what's going on.
sentences.zh: 你其实并不知道发生了什么。

sentences.en: Probably because I took my anxiety meds today.
sentences.zh: 大概是因为我今天吃了抗焦虑药吧。

sentences.en: I had that get mine increased recently actually.
sentences.zh: 我最近确实刚把药量加大了。

sentences.en: Um, so I'm, I'm good now.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以我现在状态挺好。

sentences.en: How many milligrams are we talking?
You do seem very chill though.
sentences.zh: 不过你看起来确实非常冷静。

sentences.en: Like you're getting yelled at about your dog.
sentences.zh: 就像有人因为你的狗朝你大吼大叫。

sentences.en: She's yelling at us about the line.
sentences.zh: 她因为排队的事对我们大吼大叫。

sentences.en: I think that as I get older, I just care less.
sentences.zh: 我觉得随着年龄增长，我变得更不在乎了。

sentences.en: So that, that has something to do with it.
sentences.zh: 所以，这跟那有一定关系。

sentences.en: There is that about getting older that I like.
sentences.zh: 变老带来的这一点我挺喜欢的。

sentences.en: I felt that in my thirties for sure.
sentences.zh: 我三十多岁的时候确实有这种感觉。

sentences.en: I'm like hardly even present on this earth.
sentences.zh: 我感觉自己在这个世界上几乎都不存在了。
就像一个漂浮的意识体。
不受周围一切事物的影响。

sentences.en: Um, I don't, I think they start judging at 10.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我不知道，我想他们10点开始评判。

sentences.en: There are so many ferret categories.
sentences.zh: 雪貂的组别实在太多了。

sentences.en: Just blizzards of categories and subcategories.
sentences.zh: 各种组别和子组别铺天盖地。

sentences.en: But there's really only one that matters to us.
sentences.zh: 但对我们来说真正重要的只有一个。

sentences.en: The big one that Genesis will compete in.
sentences.zh: 杰尼斯要参加的那个重量级比赛。

sentences.en: It's going to be a long day.
Which means I have approximately seven hours to marinate in ferrets and try out the whole ferret lifestyle.
sentences.zh: 这意味着我有大约七个小时的时间泡在雪貂堆里，体验整个雪貂的生活方式。

sentences.en: So we're just walking around kind of getting the scene and interviewing people.
sentences.zh: 所以我们只是四处走走，了解下现场并采访大家。

sentences.en: And as I start talking to ferret owners.
sentences.zh: 当我开始和雪貂主人交流时。

sentences.en: What is it like about a ferret?
sentences.zh: 雪貂有什么特别之处吗？

sentences.en: Was it something that like appealed to you?
sentences.zh: 这是一种吸引你的东西吗？

sentences.en: I feel like, oh, these are kind of my people.
sentences.zh: 我觉得，噢，这些人真对我的胃口。

sentences.en: Ferret people are their own special breed.
sentences.zh: 养雪貂的人绝对是一类独特的人。

sentences.en: It's always good to get together with a group of ferret people.
sentences.zh: 和一群雪貂爱好者聚在一起总是很棒的。
而且每个人都非常友善。

sentences.en: Anyone can own a cat or a dog.
sentences.zh: 任何人都可以养猫或养狗。

sentences.en: She has ferrets on her shoes.
sentences.zh: 她的鞋子上印着雪貂图案。

sentences.en: She's got so many ferret pins on her hat.
sentences.zh: 她的帽子的别着好多雪貂徽章。

sentences.en: But ferret owners take things to a whole different level.
sentences.zh: 但雪貂主人把事情提升到了一个完全不同的水平。

sentences.en: That was my first ferret in 1982.
sentences.zh: 那是我的第一只雪貂，在1982年。

sentences.en: And then after that, I got more, of course, because there's ferret math, as you can ask any of these guys.
sentences.zh: 在那之后，我当然又养了更多，因为有“雪貂数学”，你可以问问这里的任何人。

sentences.en: I came home with 27 ferrets when I was only going to come home with three.
sentences.zh: 我本打算只带三只雪貂回家，结果带回了27只。

sentences.en: How many ferrets do you have?

sentences.zh: 对我的标准来说算少的了。

sentences.en: They're really cute and they're fun to play with.
sentences.zh: 它们真的很可爱，而且玩起来很有趣。

sentences.en: He just came up to me and he was just loving and just really cute.
sentences.zh: 他径直朝我走来，表现得很亲人，超级可爱。

sentences.en: I started playing with musky for 10 minutes and I absolutely fell in love.
sentences.zh: 我开始跟小麝香玩了10分钟，就彻底坠入爱河了。

sentences.en: The love ferret people have for their ferrets.
sentences.zh: 雪貂爱好者对它们的爱。

sentences.en: I love my little golden nuggets.
It is a special love that can lead to some pretty wild situations.
sentences.zh: 这是一种特殊的爱，有时会引发一些相当疯狂的状况。

sentences.en: I set up a baby pool.
Like filling a pool with cool whip.
sentences.zh: 就像在泳池里注满冰激凌奶油。

sentences.en: And the next thing you know, we let the ferrets go.
sentences.zh: 接下来的事你也知道，我们把雪貂放进去了。

sentences.en: Of course, some of them just lit.
sentences.zh: 当然，有些家伙直接就嗨了。

sentences.en: But after a while, you've seen them coming up through the cool whip and down through the cool whip.
sentences.zh: 但过了一会儿，你就会看到它们在冰激凌奶油里钻进钻出。

sentences.en: And it was, it was chaos.
sentences.zh: 场面简直，简直是一团糟。
简直是一团绝对的混乱。
我们是董事会成员、前任会长。

sentences.en: She's current treasurer and I'm in charge of shit.
sentences.zh: 她是现任财务，而我负责管杂事。

sentences.en: At one end of the hall, up on a stage, sit two official looking women.
sentences.zh: 在大厅的一头，舞台上坐着两位看起来很官方的女士。
莎莉·海伯和维姬·麦基米。

sentences.en: They've been working together in the ferret world since the 1990s.
sentences.zh: 她们自20世纪90年代以来就一直在雪貂界合作。

sentences.en: And their official duties have taken them all over the place.
sentences.zh: 她们的官方职责让她们去过各种各样的地方。

sentences.en: We helped the folks in Japan set up their organization.
sentences.zh: 我们帮助日本的朋友们建立了他们的组织。

sentences.en: Sally and Vicki helped establish the American Ferret Association's official judging criteria.
sentences.zh: 莎莉和维姬帮助制定了美国雪貂协会的官方评判标准。

sentences.en: We wrote the standard in a perspective of what did nature mean it to be.
sentences.zh: 我们是从自然原本赋予它们什么特质的角度来编写标准的。

sentences.en: So what we're looking for is...
They're looking at every little bit from snout to tail.
sentences.zh: 他们正在检查从口鼻到尾巴的每一个小细节。

sentences.en: So we're actually feeling all the bones.
sentences.zh: 所以我们实际上是在摸所有的骨头。

sentences.en: And then we go into the muscle mass.
Hundreds of ferrets will pass through the expert hands of Sally and Vicki today.
sentences.zh: 今天将有数百只雪貂通过莎莉和维姬专业的手。

sentences.en: Including Aaron's ferrets, Genesis, and Gooseberry.
sentences.zh: 包括艾琳的雪貂，创世纪和醋栗。

sentences.en: If they puncture, draw blood, they're out of here for all three judges.
sentences.zh: 如果它们咬破皮肤、流血了，三位裁判一致决定直接淘汰。

sentences.en: Regardless if the other judges have seen them or not.
sentences.zh: 不管其他裁判有没有看到它们。

sentences.en: This is a long day for you.
sentences.zh: 对你们来说这是漫长的一天。

sentences.en: I want to be back there.
Get back in the hot tub.
We do this as a line showing if you've never been here before.
sentences.zh: 如果你们以前没来过，我们是排队展示的。

sentences.en: So therefore the judges do not know who is bringing their ferrets up to be seen.
sentences.zh: 因此裁判并不知道是谁把雪貂带上台来展示的。
对，因为他们的进度落后了。

sentences.en: So I don't even know anymore.
sentences.zh: 所以我现在什么也不知道了。

sentences.en: I am a little concerned because I have an appointment to get to at 7.30 today.
sentences.zh: 我有点担心，因为我今天7点半有个预约。

sentences.en: So I don't know what I'm going to do.
sentences.zh: 所以我不知道该怎么办了。

sentences.en: In the middle of all this, Erin tells me that she has decided to buy a car today.
sentences.zh: 正当这一切进行时，艾琳告诉我她决定今天买辆车。

sentences.en: I acquired another ferret while I was here.
sentences.zh: 我在这里又收养了一只雪貂。

sentences.en: So, um, and then I was thinking to myself, where is it going to go?
sentences.zh: 所以，嗯，然后我心里想，它要住哪儿呢？

sentences.en: I hadn't thought that far, to be honest with you.
sentences.zh: 说实话，我还没想那么远。

sentences.en: And that's a little embarrassing, but I figured it out.
sentences.zh: 这有点尴尬，不过我想出办法了。

sentences.en: And you had not planned this when you left New York.
sentences.zh: 你离开纽约时可没计划这个。

sentences.en: It was, I mean, it was in the, it was on the back of my mind.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这其实在，在我的脑海深处盘旋。

sentences.en: My car is almost old enough to vote.
sentences.zh: 我的车都快到法定投票年龄了。

sentences.en: It has a giant rust hole in the side, and I still cannot bring myself to buy a new one.
sentences.zh: 它的侧面有一个巨大的生锈洞，但我还是舍不得买辆新的。

sentences.en: What kind of car are you getting?
It's a Hyundai Santa Fe Sport 2013.
sentences.zh: 是一辆现代圣达菲运动版2013款。

sentences.en: This has already been, by far, the most ferret-y day of my life.
sentences.zh: 这已经是迄今为止我一生中最充满雪貂气息的一天了。

sentences.en: And yet, as the hours crawl by.
sentences.zh: 然而，随着时间一分一秒地爬过。

sentences.en: It keeps getting exponentially more ferret-y.
sentences.zh: 它变得呈指数级更加充满雪貂气息。

sentences.en: To see who has the fattest ferret.
sentences.zh: 看看谁拥有最肥的雪貂。

sentences.en: And then we peruse the infinite merch tables.
sentences.zh: 然后我们浏览了无数的周边商品摊位。

sentences.en: You going to buy any merch?
So many t-shirts to choose from.
sentences.zh: 有这么多的T恤可供选择。

sentences.en: I'm definitely going to buy a shirt.
I think I'm going to buy the introverted but willing to discuss ferrets.
sentences.zh: 我想我要买那件写着“性格内向但愿意讨论雪貂”的。

sentences.en: There's a black shirt that says, ferret hair?
sentences.zh: 有一件黑色的衬衫上面写着，雪貂毛？

sentences.en: It's covered with little white lines that looks like actual ferret hair.
sentences.zh: 上面布满了看起来像真实雪貂毛的小白线。

sentences.en: There's another shirt that says, unless you're a ferret, please get away from it.
sentences.zh: 还有另一件衬衫写着，除非你是一只雪貂，否则请离它远点。

sentences.en: That's the one you should get.
sentences.zh: 这就是你应该买的那件。

sentences.en: By late afternoon, things are so far behind schedule that the schedule might as well not have existed.
sentences.zh: 到了傍晚，日程进度已经落后得面目全非，日程表简直形同虚设。

sentences.en: And I've reached a point I didn't think was possible.
sentences.zh: 我达到了一个我原以为不可能的境界。

sentences.en: I feel like I'm going ferret blind.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我快要对雪貂“盲目”了。

sentences.en: Like I can't see ferrets anymore.
sentences.zh: 就好像我再也看不见雪貂了一样。
我已经见过太多雪貂了。

sentences.en: I've maybe had my fill of ferrets.
sentences.zh: 我可能对雪貂感到心满意足了。

sentences.en: But that doesn't stop Erin from trying to sell me one of her future ferret babies.
sentences.zh: 但这并没有阻止艾琳试图把她未来的雪貂宝宝卖给我一只。

sentences.en: Yeah, I'm scared to get a ferret.
Maybe I'm not up to it.
All the energy it takes and all the like...
sentences.zh: 需要耗费所有的精力以及所有那些……

sentences.en: Because I get like, you know, anxious and like overwhelmed and like depressed.
sentences.zh: 因为我总是会，你知道的，感到焦虑、不知所措还有沮丧。

sentences.en: And then this ferret needs me.
Okay, so I get anxious and overwhelmed and depressed too.
sentences.zh: 好吧，其实我也会感到焦虑、不知所措和沮丧。

sentences.en: Remember, we take the same pills.
sentences.zh: 记住，我们吃的是同一种药。

sentences.en: And the way that you handle and you look at Genesis, I think you'd be a good ferret dad if you want.
sentences.zh: 而且你对待和看待珍妮丝的方式，我觉得如果你愿意的话，你会是个很好的雪貂爸爸。

sentences.en: But no, if you get one, you know, you got to get three.
sentences.zh: 但说真的，如果你要养一只，你知道的，你得养三只。

sentences.en: I thought two was kind of the magic number.
sentences.zh: 我以为二才算是个魔幻数字。

sentences.en: No, because two is harder because then they'll bond together maybe.
sentences.zh: 不，因为两只更难，因为那样的话它们可能会黏在一起。

sentences.en: And then if one of them dies, the other one gets really sad and it dies shortly thereafter.
sentences.zh: 然后如果其中一只死了，另一只就会非常伤心，不久之后也会死掉。

sentences.en: So if you have three, it's just a better life.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你有三只，生活会过得更好。

sentences.en: Three is like having one, but better.
sentences.zh: 养三只就像养一只一样，但感觉更好。

sentences.en: Looks like we're ready for the Breeder Jills.
sentences.zh: 看起来我们该迎接母繁育貂的评选了。

sentences.en: Finally, it's time for Genesis to be crowned the greatest ferret ever to live on planet Earth.
sentences.zh: 终于，是时候让珍妮丝加冕为地球上有史以来最棒的雪貂了。

sentences.en: We head to the stage where Sally and Vicky are working their way down the line.
sentences.zh: 我们走向舞台，萨莉和维姬正在依次进行评判。

sentences.en: And then they get to Genesis.
I don't know if that's good or bad.
There's like a maraca portion of the judging and a rubber duck portion.
sentences.zh: 评判环节里好像有一个沙锤测试和一个橡皮鸭测试。

sentences.en: Like she responded well to the duck.
sentences.zh: 就像她对那只鸭子反应很好一样。

sentences.en: As we wait for the scores to be tallied, for the finalists to be called up.
sentences.zh: 在我们等待统计分数、宣布入围决赛名单的时候。

sentences.en: It's like Erin is over there getting all packed up.
sentences.zh: 感觉艾琳在那边已经把东西全收拾好了。

sentences.en: I see Erin leaving the hall.
sentences.zh: 我看到艾琳离开会场了。

sentences.en: She's coming back after she gets her new car.
sentences.zh: 她提了新车之后就会回来。

sentences.en: This means I am in charge now.
sentences.zh: 这意味着现在我说了算。

sentences.en: We are ready for callbacks for greater.
sentences.zh: 我们准备好迎接复赛了。

sentences.en: I'm standing clenching my sweaty fists as the announcer calls back all the ferrets that have placed in Genesis' category.
sentences.zh: 当广播员叫回所有在珍妮丝组别中获奖的雪貂时，我站在那里，握紧了冒汗的拳头。

sentences.en: Yeah, I feel too blasted to talk to anybody.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我觉得精疲力竭，谁也不想搭理。

sentences.en: I got all swept up in the rush of competition, and now my nervous system feels like a dirty old wrung out sponge.
sentences.zh: 我全身心投入到比赛的狂热中，现在我的神经系统感觉就像一块又脏又旧、被拧干的海绵。

sentences.en: By this point, we've been here almost 12 hours.
sentences.zh: 到这个时候，我们已经在这里呆了将近12个小时了。

sentences.en: Things are running so late that the guy who rented out the hall is standing in the doorway looking furious with his keys in his hand.
sentences.zh: 进度严重滞后，以至于租下这个大厅的那个人正站在门口，手里拿着钥匙，一脸怒容。

sentences.en: This photography is going to be shoved out about him.
sentences.zh: 这些摄影师马上就要被他赶出去了。

sentences.en: The vendors and breeders are all scrambling, packing their merch and breaking down tables.
sentences.zh: 摊主和繁育者们都在争分夺秒地收拾商品、拆卸桌子。

sentences.en: One of the winning ferrets gets her foot stuck in the trophy.
sentences.zh: 一只获奖雪貂的脚被卡在奖杯里了。

sentences.en: And the whole thing is ending in a crescendo of ferret chaos.
sentences.zh: 整个过程在一片雪貂造成的混乱高潮中结束了。

sentences.en: All right, we've got to lose ferret.
sentences.zh: 好了，我们有一只雪貂走丢了。

sentences.en: But someone needs to identify it.
And yet, somehow, there is still one last category left to judge.
sentences.zh: 然而，不知怎的，居然还有一个最后的组别等待评判。

sentences.en: It's called passport for ferrets with foreign ancestry.
sentences.zh: 这个组别叫“护照”，专门给有外国血统的雪貂评选。

sentences.en: Which means gooseberry, our Hungarian ferret, will be the last chance to win anything.
sentences.zh: 这意味着醋栗，我们的匈牙利雪貂，将成为赢得任何奖项的最后机会。

sentences.en: And I really want the two of us to get a win.
sentences.zh: 我真的很想让我们俩拿个奖回去。
所以我打开它的航空箱。

sentences.en: I look at him, and he looks at me.
Then he pops right out and nestles into my hands like he belongs there.
sentences.zh: 然后它直接蹦了出来，依偎进我的手里，就像它本来就属于那里一样。

sentences.en: Like he's been custom-shaped to fit my grip.
sentences.zh: 就像它是为我的手掌量身定制的一样。
它对我的胡子很感兴趣。

sentences.en: He's definitely going to shoot out of my hands in a second here.
sentences.zh: 它绝对马上就要从我手里窜出去了。

sentences.en: Vicky beckons us up to her table.
sentences.zh: 维姬招手叫我们去她的桌子旁。

sentences.en: She twists and turns gooseberry in her hands.
sentences.zh: 她在手中翻来覆去地检查醋栗。

sentences.en: She looks in his mouth and his ears.
sentences.zh: 她查看它的嘴巴和耳朵。

sentences.en: And he doesn't bite her or claw her.
sentences.zh: 而它既没有咬她也没有抓她。

sentences.en: For once, he's actually a good boy.
sentences.zh: 破天荒地，它居然表现得很乖。

sentences.en: And then very matter-of-factly, she hands him back to me.
sentences.zh: 然后她非常公事公办地把它还给了我。
就像它是我的雪貂一样。

sentences.en: We've always meant to do something.
It would be a really good place for a ferret.
sentences.zh: 那对雪貂来说会是个非常好的地方。

sentences.en: They could really run around and have their own space.
sentences.zh: 它们可以尽情奔跑，拥有自己的空间。

sentences.en: They wouldn't smell up the rest of the house.
sentences.zh: 它们就不会把家里其他地方弄得有味道了。

sentences.en: In eighth place, it's nine and five.
Vicky starts calling out the winners, countdown style.
sentences.zh: 维姬开始以倒计时的方式宣读获奖者。

sentences.en: Sam has to show Gooseberry again to break a tie.
sentences.zh: 萨姆不得不再次展示醋栗来打破平局。

sentences.en: And first place, best place goes to 1-0-8.
sentences.zh: 第一名，也就是最好的名次，归属于108号。

sentences.en: In the final competition of the Buckeye Bash, Gooseberry, the world's most ferretty ferret, has won second place.
sentences.zh: 在七叶树狂欢节的压轴比赛中，醋栗——这只最具雪貂特色的雪貂，赢得了第二名。

sentences.en: I pick up my triumphant green ribbon.
sentences.zh: 我拿起我那条象征胜利的绿色缎带。

sentences.en: And Gooseberry and I get our official Buckeye Bash photo.
sentences.zh: 我和醋栗拍了我们的七叶树狂欢节官方合影。

sentences.en: I told you we'd do it.
sentences.zh: 我告诉过你我们能做到的。

sentences.en: I told you coming into today, you were a star and a champion.
sentences.zh: 今天来的时候我就告诉过你，你就是个明星和冠军。

sentences.en: Just then, Erin texts us a photo of her new car, a brown Hyundai with a giant yellow bow on it.
sentences.zh: 就在这时，艾琳发给我们一张她新车的照片，是一辆棕色的现代汽车，上面系着一个巨大的黄色蝴蝶结。

sentences.en: It's big enough to fit her dog, her friend Karen, and all of her ferrets, at least for now.
sentences.zh: 这车够大，至少目前装得下她的狗、她的朋友凯伦以及她所有的雪貂。

sentences.en: And we text her back a photo of me with my ribbon holding Goose, looking almost terrifyingly happy.
sentences.zh: 我们回给她一张照片，上面是我拿着缎带抱着醋栗，脸上带着几乎可以说是吓人的开心笑容。
祝你们度过美好的夜晚。

sentences.en: She says she'll be wrapped up with paperwork for a while, and asks if I will take the ferrets back to the hotel.
sentences.zh: 她说她还要忙一会儿纸质文件，问我能不能把雪貂带回酒店。

sentences.en: Which, of course, I'd love nothing more.
When we meet Erin, I tell her everything.
sentences.zh: 当我们见到艾琳时，我把一切都告诉了她。
所以这就是你们所有的缎带了。

sentences.en: Yeah, I was going to say, you're going to give that one up?
sentences.zh: 对，我本想说，你要放弃那个吗？

sentences.en: And then I reluctantly surrender my ribbon, which I was hoping she would let me keep.
sentences.zh: 然后我很不情愿地交出了缎带，本来我希望她能让我留着的。

sentences.en: Thank you for doing that for me, for being there.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你为我做这一切，谢谢你在我身边。

sentences.en: We all say goodbye, and when I leave, my ferrets stay behind.
sentences.zh: 我们都道了别，当我离开时，我的雪貂留在了那里。

sentences.zh: 本期节目由水晶·杜海姆和拉里萨·安德森制作，凯特琳提供协助

sentences.en: It was reported by me, Sam Anderson, and edited by Wendy Doerr and Larissa Anderson.
sentences.zh: 由我、萨姆·安德森报道，温迪·多尔和拉里萨·安德森剪辑。

sentences.zh: 由马里恩·洛扎诺担任音频工程。

sentences.zh: 我们的执行制作人是宝拉·舒曼。

sentences.zh: 原创音乐由马里恩·洛扎诺、丹·鲍威尔和艾莉西亚巴·埃图普创作。
由凯特琳·洛夫进行事实核查。

sentences.zh: 特别感谢杰克·西尔弗斯坦、萨莎·韦斯和萨姆·多尔尼克。

sentences.en: Also, to all the ferret people who showed me their ways, Scarlet Grace Sailing, Sally
sentences.zh: 还要感谢所有向我展示他们养貂之道的雪貂爱好者们，斯嘉丽·格雷斯·萨林、萨利

sentences.en: Heber, Vicki McKimmy, and all the many others I met at the bash and at the hotel bar, who told me that ferrets don't actually smell all that bad, and I should just get one.
sentences.zh: 赫伯、维姬·麦金米，以及我在聚会和酒店酒吧遇到的许多其他人，他们告诉我雪貂其实没那么臭，我应该养一只。

sentences.en: Aaron Ehrman now runs Sugar and Spice Ferretry, and I am happy to report that last summer,
sentences.zh: 亚伦·埃尔曼现在经营着“糖与香料”雪貂场，我很高兴地向大家汇报，去年夏天，

sentences.en: Genesis gave birth to a litter of 10 gorgeous kits.
sentences.zh: 珍妮丝生下了一窝10只可爱的小雪貂。

sentences.zh: 您可以在各大播客平台收听我们的所有节目，或者访问我们的网站 nytimes.com/animal。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器在运转。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了许多自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场残酷、混乱、有时又扣人心弦的权力争斗中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《都市》中，我和萨拉·科尼格将带您了解那些试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的人的故事。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 请在各大播客平台收听。
